rpi.name: Remote Package Installer
rpi.author: by flatZ
rpi.desc: The first Remote Package Installer of the scene made by flatZ. It has been build in 2019 and have no latest updates yet. It is known as the legacy default way to install PKG's through Network.
rpi.troubleshoot: Any troubles are addressed in the Troubleshooting Guide.

rpiOop.name: Remote Package Installer [Open Orbis Port]
rpiOop.author: by njzydark
rpiOop.desc: Fork of the RPI OOP by Njzydark with latest updates. Check GitHub repositories to compare the updates. If flatZ RPI doesn't work for you, you should test this one out.

rpiOopBackporter.name: Remote Package Installer [Open Orbis Port]
rpiOopBackporter.author: by backporter
rpiOopBackporter.desc: Backporter is working on a new version of the Remote Package Installer porting it from flatZ version to a new one with the Open Orbis SDK.
rpiOopBackporter.version: Below you can find the direct version 1.0 and the GitHub repo.

hbStore.name: HB-Store R2
hbStore.author: by LightningMods
hbStore.desc: The official Homebrew App Store build by Darksoftware LLC.
hbStore.permission: Thanks to LightningMods I am permitted to use the API in the app. This means, you can Download and Install HB-Store Apps directly.

cdnServer.name: HB-Store CDN Server
cdnServer.author: by Gkiokan
cdnServer.desc: With the CDN Server you can host all your local PKG files with an ease to the HB-Store. It supports name fixing and sub directory scans based on a base Path, and is also cross plattform available.
cdnServer.cli: There is also a CLI-Version that is even supported officially by RetroNAS!
